body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 5dd1da84e584a554644f843afec5dc29ff6319aa -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** No blocking items were found.

The PR is still a draft. The author or the maintainer must flag it ready before the merge.

## What looks good

- The WCS page now has four rows: Origin, X axis, Y axis and Z axis. Each row has its own `Pick` and `Clear` button and shows the feature name or "not set". This agrees with #2625, items 1 to 4.
- `Apply` uses the existing `align_roles` check and queues one undoable `SetWcs`. The active-setup check stays. No new command, no new derivation and no direct world write is added.
- The cause is found and fixed: `wcs_pick::arm` now stops `wcs_ui.pick_circle` and `wcs_ui.pick_anchor`. These modes took the viewport click before the role draft.
- The pinning tests use real viewport picks (`interact::pick_at`) for face, edge and corner in each role. They also check the row replacement, the row clear, the global Clear and the parallel-axis refusal.
- The PR body has before and after screenshots. They are on the fork `pr-screenshots` branch, not in the PR tree.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/2625-wcs-pick-table.md`, the `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #2625` are present. There is no `CHANGELOG.md` edit, no snapshot PNG, no golden and no process file in the diff.
- Safety tier: no. The diff changes only `crates/ui` and a decision file. Posted G-code, the gouge and collision checks, stock simulation and geometry do not change. `SetWcs` and `align_roles` do not change.

## Results, merged with main

Built and tested locally, on the PR head `5dd1da84e` trial-merged with `upstream/main` `370d38df6`. The merge had no conflicts.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 9 of 9 steps green |
| ui lib (unit tests) | 1224 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored |
| ui:boundary, boundary_picks, sinker_setup, tap_hand, theme_example, theme_files, waterjet_tool | 3, 7, 2, 3, 3, 17, 1 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Mutations, run by the reviewer (each one reverted after the run):

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| Remove the `pick_circle` / `pick_anchor` reset in `wcs_pick::arm` | red: `role_picking_stops_circle_picks`, `role_picking_stops_anchor_picks` |
| Remove `d.role = role` after a row `Pick` click in `wcs_pick_row.rs` | red: `each_role_button_routes_viewport_features_to_its_own_row` and 3 more |
| Make the row `Clear` keep the pick in `wcs_pick_row.rs` | red: `each_role_button_routes_viewport_features_to_its_own_row` |

## Requested before merge

None.

## Notes (not blocking)

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/wcs_page.rs:239` and `:303`: the fix covers one order only. If the user arms a role row first and then arms "Pick a circular edge" or "Pick markers in viewport", the role row stays lit. But `wcs_circle_pick.rs:34` then takes the next click first. A follow-up issue (P7) can make those two controls pause the role draft.
2. `crates/ui/src/wcs_pick.rs:3` still says "stamped with the role chosen in the row's box". The test name at `crates/ui/src/wcs_pick.rs:118` still says "role_box". There is no box now.
3. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/wcs_page_picks.rs:81` and `:84`: the assertion messages still say "Pick for WCS". The label is now "Pick Z axis".
4. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/wcs_pick_click_tests.rs:108`: the check `query_all_by_label_contains("part")` is weak. A check on the Z row text, with `geo_label` of the pick, is stronger.
5. A row stays armed after its pick lands, so the next viewport click replaces that pick. Only Clear or a page change stops it. This agrees with #2625 item 3, but a "stop" state on a second `Pick` click can help the user.
6. The after screenshot shows four empty rows. A screenshot with picked features shows the names better.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
